title: A benchmarks.py run leaves its run-<pid>-<hex> scratch directory behind, a --dry-run too, and the directories are not tidy records so they accumulate
goal: Bench.close removes the run's own scratch directory when it holds no raw log worth keeping, and a benchmarks.py run with --dry-run makes none, so no run-<pid>-<hex> directory is left behind

run:
import os, subprocess, sys, tempfile
t = tempfile.mkdtemp()
subprocess.run([sys.executable, "_tools/benchmarks.py", "run", "pool", "--dry-run", "--sample", "1"], capture_output=True, env=dict(os.environ, BENCH_SCRATCH=t))
left = [n for n in os.listdir(t) if n.startswith("run-")]
print(left); sys.exit(1 if left else 0)

import os, subprocess, sys, tempfile; t=tempfile.mkdtemp(); subprocess.run([sys.executable, "_tools/benchmarks.py", "run", "pool", "--dry-run", "--sample", "1"], capture_output=True, env=dict(os.environ, BENCH_SCRATCH=t)); sys.exit(1 if [n for n in os.listdir(t) if n.startswith("run-")] else 0)

import sys, tempfile, pathlib; sys.path.insert(0, "_tools"); import bench_core; d=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())/"run-1-abcd1234"; b=bench_core.Bench(d, 1); b.close(); sys.exit(1 if d.exists() else 0)
